environment.guest_settings: scrub inherited PS2_/GT4_PERF_ options; set GT4_PERF=1 PS2_SCALE=1 PS2_GS=gpu
environment.vulkan: preserve and record VK_ overrides in session result; other driver/overlay state not controlled
environment.gs_submission: GT4_GS_SYNC=0 default (asynchronous); GT4_GS_SYNC=1 restores the fully synchronous path (launcher records the value in the session result)
environment.pacing: GT4_PACING unset or paced (default): paced clock. GT4_PACING=audio: blocking WinMM clock as in slice152. GT4_PRESENT_MODE unset or fifo (default); mailbox and immediate are experiments and fail at swapchain creation when the surface lacks them. The launcher refuses other values and records both names in result.json (pacing_environment).

toolchain.build: CMake/Ninja VS2022 x64 ABI Windows SDK10.0.26100.0

classification: TASK-042: the JIT-free gt4-gs.exe 0.4.0 (fork build option GT4GS_ONLY): no EE/IOP/VU/VIF recompilers, no x86 emitter, no GS software JIT (the software rasterizer uses PCSX2's C functions), no executable memory mapping, Windows Arbitrary Code Guard (ProhibitDynamicCode) enabled at start, executable-memory audit in the log. The game runtime is the slice196 build, unchanged (same file and hash); only the GS package changes. Replayed menu frames are byte-identical to gt4-gs 0.3.2 at 1x and 3x.
preserved_inputs: Same game runtime as slice196 (private/slice196-gs-deinterlace-build/build/gt4vulkan.exe, same hash), same runtime capsule (slice191-gs-stream-runtime), port (slice191-gs-stream-port), shaders (slice153-pacing-shaders), EE library, VU1 and VU0 tables; changed: the pinned gt4-gs package (0.4.0).
limits: Unsynchronized readbacks answer from the PCSX2 GS local memory copy: GPU-drawn pixels are stale (zeros in the gs_live_check sprite test), so the night-race lens flare may change; accurate is the default.
Deferred swap chain acquire and detached input queues are checked only with hidden windows; the owner checks the visible window (fullscreen, Alt+Tab, minimize).
Interlaced races (480i held) and the 1080i/PAL modes are not checked; only the menus streams (slice191 and slice196) were replayed headless.

Arbitrary Code Guard is checked with the AMD driver of this PC only; a driver that needs dynamic code in the GS process would fail at device creation ([GT4GS] ProhibitDynamicCode = false is the switch, not exposed by the launcher).

CPU sprite and CPU CLUT render (user hacks, off for GT4) and the software renderer run the C rasterizer: slower than the 0.3.2 JIT (CPU sprite plus CLUT render on the menus stream: GS thread 6.5 ms/frame against 5.4).
Save states are refused in pcsx2 mode.
